facts.text: Rosewood Miramar Beach is in Montecito, California.
The accommodation is made up of beach houses, bungalows and suites facing the Pacific Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Beach houses, bungalows and suites are a front-row seat to the Pacific Ocean

facts.text: The Garden Bungalow Suites sit within landscaped gardens in the center of the estate.
facts.excerpt: Nestled within lush landscaping in the center of our estate, unwind to the sounds of chirping birds and scents of lush gardens.

facts.text: The hotel describes the Ambassador Suite as the premier suite at the resort.
facts.excerpt: The Ambassador Suite at Rosewood Miramar Beach blends coastal sophistication, bespoke luxury, and estate-style living—making it the premier suite at the resort.

facts.text: Caruso's serves seasonal menus paired with fine wines and signature cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Seasonal menus, crafted with fresh ingredients, paired with fine wines and signature cocktails.

facts.text: The Manor Bar serves literary cocktails in a space with a collection of books and art.
facts.excerpt: Literary cocktails, inspired stories and a lively space amid a collection of books and art.

facts.text: AMA Sushi is led by California-born Chef Scott Yonamine, who has spent two decades honing his craft.
facts.excerpt: Led by California-born Chef Scott Yonamine, who has spent two decades honing his craft.

facts.text: The Revere Room serves California dining.
facts.excerpt: Quintessential California dining in an elegant yet inviting atmosphere.

facts.text: Miramar Beach Bar is the hotel's beachfront restaurant, serving cocktails and bites.
facts.excerpt: Refreshing cocktails and bites in a lively ambiance at our beachfront restaurant.

facts.text: At FronteMare, the Caruso's team prepares food live along the coastline for guests gathered around a communal table.
facts.excerpt: Prepared live along the coastline, the team at Caruso’s welcomes guests to gather around a communal table.

facts.text: The Miramar Surf Club offers surfing alongside local surfers as a taste of Santa Barbara's surf culture.
facts.excerpt: Catch the perfect wave alongside local legends for a taste of Santa Barbara’s surf culture.

facts.text: Luxury brand shops, from CHANEL to Zegna, are on the property within steps of the accommodations.
facts.excerpt: Rosewood Miramar Beach offers luxury brands renowned for exceptional craftsmanship and style from CHANEL to Zegna, all within steps from accommodations.

facts.text: A Book Concierge stay is offered in collaboration with Godmothers Bookstore.
facts.excerpt: In collaboration with Godmothers Bookstore, guests are invited to begin the year with a thoughtfully curated stay designed to slow the pace and reset the mind.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself The American Riviera Estate.
